campaignGateFinding: All eight HD1 residual clusters now recur after independent source lock in three chronological epochs and across at least three materially different domains. They pass the historical recurrence pre-gate, but none is promoted: HD0 reserves synthesis/promotion for HD9 and classifier/sampling uncertainty remains active.
worldModelReading: Three-epoch recurrence is materially stronger evidence that R1–R8 reflect recurring pressures in Reality rather than one era-specific narrative. It does not establish primitive status, universal necessity, shared implementation or lawhood.
